reviews.text: Vicki is truly an incredible human being and an asset to this store, she has made such a difficult time losing a beloved pet alot easier with nothing but love and care. I will be always so grateful for the kindness and help she has provided
Great for pets.

Worst arrogant recepionist hv ever come across.Im a scan angel and found an injured cat who was chipped and took her to vet receptionist to seek help contacting owner of the cat. I provided microchip details to receptionist n she said she look into it. After this i waited 30 minutes watching her deal with customers without any update.when i asked how long u will take she replied tat she dealing with other customers so when she find time she will contact. I said she could tell me this 30 min earlier tat she didnt even try to make contact as she was prioritising her customers coz i would not hv wasted my time n taken her to other vets. She replied "tats fine" if u want to go u can. NO APOLOGY no empathy. I stormed out n called the lodege vets who resolved it over the phone in 5 minutes. This is the difference between good vets n horrible vets. Management need to caution this receptionist for he arrogance and unproffesionalism. Zero empathy for pets
Yes, it was a very good experience, but very warm
Great vets, Dr Jules and team are lovely and always take good care of my dogs.

I am extremely disappointed with the service I have received from Vets for Pets Stechford.

Yesterday (29th June), I tried calling repeatedly from 9:00am until around 12:30pm, and not once did anyone answer the phone. My cat has been unwell with stomach issues and hasn’t been eating, so I needed to buy the special food she has been prescribed.

As I couldn’t get through, I drove to the practice. When I asked if there was a problem with the phones, I was told that a new member of staff was being trained. The new employee was sitting beside the receptionist, and I witnessed the phones being left off the hook. The receptionist simply pressed a button while the phones remained off the hook, meaning no calls were coming through.

Given the recent heatwave, I can only imagine how many owners were trying to contact the practice with seriously unwell pets. It is deeply concerning that no contingency appeared to be in place while staff training was taking place.

To make matters worse, I tried calling again this morning and still received no answer. As a result, I have now had to register my cat with a different veterinary practice because I no longer have confidence that I could rely on this one in an emergency.

I find this level of service completely unacceptable and highly unprofessional. Training new staff is important, but it should never come at the expense of answering calls from worried pet owners, especially when animals may need urgent care. I genuinely feel sorry for anyone trying to contact this practice with a sick or injured pet.
Very professional

1) Never answer the phone
2) Always money before treatment/help
3) Used to have such a wonderful Vet surgeon (name pronounced Yon’), when he left, the clinic hasn’t been the same.

Jules and Vicky!! Just amazing, inside and out!
Any vets these days just want your money, no feelings but not this place. They are always so happy to help, I feel they go above and beyond and I just can’t thank you enough.
You know exactly what you are talking about, only prescribe medication that is needed and are so kind and gentle with our pets. 🐾 ❤️
I will always continue to recommend this vets! X

I would like to leave a review for Zaynab at the vets. She made me feel so at ease when my cat went in to be spayed. Her calm and caring nature was exactly what I needed during a very anxious time.

She was incredibly kind and gentle with my cat, Sassy, and it was clear that she truly cares about the animals she looks after. Because of her, what could have been a very stressful experience became so much easier for me.

I struggle with quite bad anxiety, but Zaynab’s reassurance, kindness, and professionalism made the whole experience so much nicer. She really is amazing and clearly made for the job. I’m very grateful for the care she gave both me and Sassy.
Animals are treated with respect 🙏 …

We took our cat Ziggy to Stechford Vets for Pets this evening and were greeted warmly by the lovely receptionist, Carol, who was incredibly helpful when Ziggy’s appointment wasn’t showing on the system. Despite this, Ziggy was still seen by a wonderful vet who was very knowledgeable, friendly, and put both us and Ziggy at ease. We were extremely worried, but her calm and cheerful manner really reassured us — Ziggy must have felt it too as he was very cooperative. Great vets, lovely staff, highly recommend.
Staff are very friendly

The bigger lady who works in the dog grooming section behind the desk kicked my dog thinking I didn’t see it before handing her back over after being cut. My dog wasn’t showing any behavioural issues and the kick was uncalled for. I am furious and utterly disgusted. Imagine what they do when you’re not around. Vile woman.
Really good service provided by Julian and the staff. Very polite and friendly, 5 stars!

Genuinely one of the best veterinary teams I have seen with my animals. Vets, nurses & receptionists.

Simin is such a wonderful vet, taking genuine interest and time to make sure she understood my concerns and then thoroughly communicating back to me what her thoughts were, next steps & results, ensuring I know at every stage what’s going on. One of the most caring vets I have ever seen.

All the ladies on the reception desk are really knowledgable, helpful and also incredibly caring.

The nurses ensured my cats were comfortable and ensured I had as much information as I needed/asked for.

I really would recommend them to anyone.

The vets are fantastic. However, the young receptionists are so rude. They are always speaking to you like you bother them. Each time I either call or go to pick up my cats treatment I get welcomed by rudeness.

It’s sad to see that the front of house brings this place down because the owner of the practice, nurses and the vets are fabulous.

I visited with my cat, Daisy today evening 17.10.25 to have to get her vaccinations done.
I just wanted to express my gratitude to Simmi/Vicky for an outstanding experience at the vets for pets. They provided excellent customer service with exceptional care, upmost professionalism, empathy, and courtesy.

They had such a lovely calm demeanour relieving my concerns, answering all my questions. They really went over and beyond at every moment right up from entering.
Thank you Vicky/Simmi.

Great service, I was offered an appointment the same week. They have a cat waiting area which was good. They gave me a tool so that I could give my cat the tablet easier, this really helped.

Friendly staff who were able to answer my questions.
Very professional and friendly. Took time to talk and made my pet very comfortable
Reception staff and Vets have all offered excellent service

Took my pug here suffering with discharge from his nose. Without examing dog properly at all they sent him for a referral which cost over 5,000 pounds in investigational work which was not needed at all and still had the same problem which was not resolved. We took our dog to another vets who straight away found he had 4 different types of bacterial infection cost 200 pounds problem solved. At no point would they admit they made a poor judgement an error with my pet. No offer of any refund or apology for an obvious mistake. This practice should be shut down. I'm just very fortunate I could pay this amount of money out of my own pocket a lot of people could not. This practice should be shut down or at least hold there hands up and admit a mistake was made in this case, But like a lot of these companies its just about money money money. And please don't anyone from this practice reply to this with more lame excuses I don't want to here it.
Team are very friendly

We registered with this vets in January, we have so far only needed the initial check up for my 8 month old.

We went in today to see about booking him in to be neutered but book in advance for October so we can sort work commitments out. We were told by the most miserable receptionist that it's weight dependent so we can't book as this is needed. Now I'm not stupid but I do hope that my dog is heavier in October than he is now as he is still growing so this is irrelevant at the moment, plus we know we have to pay for it so it is what it is. She then miserably said we don't book that far in advance again that is fine but I would have expected her to offer going on a list for a call back when their diary is there.
Finally I asked about their plans to be told its weight based again and it takes time to fill in the forms. This resulted in decision made move my baby's care elsewhere.

This would be 0 stars if I could.
Looking back, I was well and truly robbed!

Have been with this vets for many years. It's always a pleasure speaking with Harley at reception, both the vet and nurses are very knowledgeable, and experienced with cats. It's convenient that there's a pet shop right downstairs too. Prices are affordable and you don't have to wait weeks to get an appointment. Would highly recommend. Thank you.

Absolutely fantastic caring vets. Had a recent appointment for my guinea pig Gizmo with thier vet Simin.  She had so much compassion in her job, my guinea pig was really calm. I couldn't thank her enough for the comfort she brought.
Staff was really friendly.  My dog is very nervous but she settled really well with vet
Accommodating and great service
Very clean and wide range of help n support for all kinds of pets
